entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:1
segments: ¶A good name [is] better than precious ointment; and the day of death than the day of one's birth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:2
segments: [It is] better to go to the house of mourning, than to go to the house of feasting: for that [is] the end of all men; and the living will lay [it] to his heart.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:3
segments: Sorrow [is] better than laughter: for by the sadness of the countenance the heart is made better. {Sorrow: or, Anger}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:4
segments: The heart of the wise [is] in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools [is] in the house of mirth.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:5
segments: [It is] better to hear the rebuke of the wise, than for a man to hear the song of fools.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:6
segments: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so [is] the laughter of the fool: this also [is] vanity. {crackling: Heb. sound}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:7
segments: ¶Surely oppression maketh a wise man mad; and a gift destroyeth the heart.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:8
segments: Better [is] the end of a thing than the beginning thereof: [and] the patient in spirit [is] better than the proud in spirit.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:9
segments: Be not hasty in thy spirit to be angry: for anger resteth in the bosom of fools.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:10
segments: Say not thou, What is [the cause] that the former days were better than these? for thou dost not enquire wisely concerning this. {wisely: Heb. out of wisdom}

words.text: not thou, What is [the cause] that the former
than these? for thou dost not enquire
concerning this. {wisely: Heb. out of wisdom}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:11
segments: ¶Wisdom [is] good with an inheritance: and [by it there is] profit to them that see the sun. {good...: or, as good as an inheritance, yea, better too}

words.text: . {good...: or, as good as an inheritance, yea, better too}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:12
segments: For wisdom [is] a defence, [and] money [is] a defence: but the excellency of knowledge [is, that] wisdom giveth life to them that have it. {defence: Heb. shadow}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:13
segments: Consider the work of God: for who can make [that] straight, which he hath made crooked?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:14
segments: In the day of prosperity be joyful, but in the day of adversity consider: God also hath set the one over against the other, to the end that man should find nothing after him. {set: Heb. made}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:15
segments: All [things] have I seen in the days of my vanity: there is a just [man] that perisheth in his righteousness, and there is a wicked [man] that prolongeth [his life] in his wickedness.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:16
segments: Be not righteous over much; neither make thyself over wise: why shouldest thou destroy thyself? {destroy...: Heb. be desolate?}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:17
segments: Be not over much wicked, neither be thou foolish: why shouldest thou die before thy time? {before...: Heb. not in thy time?}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:18
segments: [It is] good that thou shouldest take hold of this; yea, also from this withdraw not thine hand: for he that feareth God shall come forth of them all.

words.text: of this; yea, also from this

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:19
segments: Wisdom strengtheneth the wise more than ten mighty [men] which are in the city.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:20
segments: For [there is] not a just man upon earth, that doeth good, and sinneth not.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:21
segments: Also take no heed unto all words that are spoken; lest thou hear thy servant curse thee: {take...: Heb. give not thine heart}

words.text: thee: {take...: Heb. give not thine heart}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:22
segments: For oftentimes also thine own heart knoweth that thou thyself likewise hast cursed others.

words.text: that thou thyself likewise hast cursed

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:23
segments: ¶All this have I proved by wisdom: I said, I will be wise; but it [was] far from me.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:24
segments: That which is far off, and exceeding deep, who can find it out?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:25
segments: I applied mine heart to know, and to search, and to seek out wisdom, and the reason [of things], and to know the wickedness of folly, even of foolishness [and] madness: {I applied...: Heb. I and mine heart compassed}

words.text: : {I applied...: Heb. I and mine heart compassed}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:26
segments: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart [is] snares and nets, [and] her hands [as] bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her. {whoso...: Heb. he that is good before God}

words.text: by her. {whoso...: Heb. he that is good before God}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:27
segments: Behold, this have I found, saith the preacher, [counting] one by one, to find out the account: {counting...: or, weighing one thing after another, to find out the reason}

words.text: : {counting...: or, weighing one thing after another, to find out the reason}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:28
segments: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

words.text: among all those have I not found

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 7:29
segments: Lo, this only have I found, that God hath made man upright; but they have sought out many inventions.
